places.title: Tea Gardens & Plantations
places.description: Endless emerald tea plantations rolling across misty hills. Tour century-old tea estates, watch fresh tea leaves plucked by local pickers, and sample authentic Munnar fresh tea.

places.title: Eravikulam National Park
places.description: Sanctuary for the endangered Nilgiri Tahr mountain goat and blooming Neelakurinji flowers. Enjoy scenic safari bus rides through high-altitude shola grasslands and Anamudi views.

places.title: Mattupetty Dam & Reservoir
places.description: A gravity dam surrounded by lush green hills and tea plantations. Enjoy thrilling speedboating, peaceful pedal boats, and frequent wild elephant sightings near the water edge.

places.title: Echo Point
places.description: A picturesque confluence of three mountain streams where natural acoustics create an enchanting echo of your voice across the misty reservoir valley and eucalyptus trees.

places.title: Top Station Viewpoint
places.description: The highest altitude point on the Munnar-Kodaikanal road offering breathtaking 360-degree panoramic views of the Western Ghats and the rolling plains of neighboring Tamil Nadu.

places.title: Attukal Waterfalls
places.description: A cascade of cool mountain water plunging through rocky cliffs surrounded by lush green foliage. An ideal spot for photography, nature treks, and refreshing mountain air.

places.title: Kundala Lake & Dam
places.description: Home to Asia's first arch dam, surrounded by fragrant pine groves. Experience unique Kashmiri-style Shikara boat rides, pedal boating, and blooming cherry blossoms in winter.

places.title: Blossom International Park
places.description: A serene 16-acre park beside the Muthirapuzha River featuring landscaped floral gardens, tree houses, children's play areas, cycling trails, and peaceful walking pathways.

places.title: Pothamedu View Point
places.description: Spectacular cliffside viewpoint looking down upon sprawling cardamom, pepper, and tea plantations. Renowned for dramatic sunset views and mist rolling through valley gorges.

places.title: Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary
places.description: A protected rain-shadow sanctuary home to the rare Grizzled Giant Squirrel, star tortoises, leopards, and sandalwood forests. Offers guided nature walks and watchtower visits.

places.title: Jatayu Earth's Center
places.description: A world-renowned tourism park featuring the world's largest functional bird sculpture, state-of-the-art cable car rides, 6D theater, and adventure activities atop Jatayu rock.

places.title: Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple
places.description: A sacred Dravidian-style architectural masterpiece dedicated to Lord Vishnu, world-famous for its intricate stone carvings, sacred gold-plated gopuram, and ancient heritage.

places.title: Varkala Cliff Beach
places.description: Kerala's only cliff beach bordering the Arabian Sea. Renowned for scenic coastal boardwalks, natural mineral water springs, seaside seafood restaurants, and panoramic sunsets.

places.title: Alappuzha Backwaters
places.description: Known as the Venice of the East, famous for tranquil palm-fringed canals, lagoon networks, traditional houseboat cruises, and peaceful village life across Vembanad Lake.

places.title: Guruvayur Sri Krishna Temple
places.description: One of India's most holy pilgrimage sites, known as Bhuloka Vaikunta. Features traditional Kerala temple rituals, elephant sanctuary visits, and cultural devotional ceremonies.
